title: Woman saw three plus signs rolling on road in 1930s

plain: In Sweden in the 1930s, a woman is said to have seen three objects shaped like plus signs rolling along a road. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells it second-hand: the account came to him through his mother, whom he says he called to ask about it. If true, it would be a strange sighting from well before UFOs were widely talked about.
